title: Restriction compatibility of tensor-sections evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an O_X-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and g:V→U an arrow of its small etale category [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For u:U→X let e_u:tensorPullback(u)≅pullback(u) be the comparison selected by uniqueness of left adjoints from the canonical tensor adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and the abstract pullback adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. Define E_U(φ) as the value at 1 of pullbackObjUnitIso(u).inv followed by φ followed by e_u.inv(F). Then E_V(etaleHom(unitObj X,F).map(g.op)(φ)) equals etaleTensorSectionsRestriction(F,g)(E_U(φ)) [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. Equivalently the maps E_U form a natural transformation from the etale Hom presheaf to the underlying set presheaf of tensor-pullback sections. This asserts only naturality, not bijectivity, and requires no quasi-coherence.

proof.text: Let e_f denote the unit-normalized left-adjoint comparison. Apply conjugateEquiv to compare e_(a≫b).inv followed by tensorSectionsComp(a,b).inv with pullbackComp(a,b).inv followed by whiskerLeft(pullback b,e_a.inv) and whiskerRight(e_b.inv,tensorPullback a). Conjugation takes each e_f.inv to the identity, both inverse composition comparisons to pushforwardComp(a,b).hom, and respects composition and whiskering. Injectivity proves the equality; invert it to obtain the forward equation.

The equation unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies e_a.hom on tensorSectionsUnit with pullbackSection. Naturality of the adjunction unit moves any module map through tensorSectionsUnit. Applying the forward comparison equation on sections thus intertwines the tensor and abstract restriction maps.

By pullbackSection_one_eq evaluation E_U is e_u.inv applied to homSection u. The existing homSection_comp equation intertwines homSection with abstract pullback restriction. Substitute the equality g.left≫U.hom=V.hom before simplifying section-map composition, which gives the identical equality transport on both sides. The etaleHom restriction is pullHom by presheafHom_map_eq_pullHom. Combining these equalities gives the component naturality identity, and function extensionality gives the displayed equality of morphisms of types. This includes identity arrows and empty schemes, since no section needs to be chosen.

theorem etaleTensorHomEvaluation_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ} (g : U ⟶ V) :
    (etaleHom (unitObj X) F).map g ≫
        TypeCat.ofHom (etaleTensorHomEvaluation F V.unop) =
      TypeCat.ofHom (etaleTensorHomEvaluation F U.unop) ≫
        (etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf F ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat).map g
